name: Ag Processing Solutions, Inc.
old_description: Ag Processing Solutions is a team of engineers and fabricators specializing in the design and construction of agricultural processing facilities tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. In addition to our design and consulting services, we operate an 11,000 sq. ft. processing facility where we offer toll cleaning, milling and pelleting for nearly any commodity under the sun. We also specialize in the fabrication and design of custom stainless steel belt conveyors for your agricultural processing facility. Whether you're looking to build a new agricultural processing plant, need help with optimizing your current facility or need custom-engineered solutions, our team has the expertise and resources to assist in your journey.
about:
Ag Processing Solutions, Inc. operates from Great Falls, Montana, where it runs an 11,000-square-foot processing facility. The company was established to serve the agricultural sector with custom facility design and toll processing services.

The firm’s core activities include the design and construction of agricultural processing plants, toll cleaning, milling, and pelleting for a wide range of commodities, and the fabrication of custom stainless steel belt conveyors. It also provides equipment sourcing and consulting for facility optimization. The 11,000 sq. ft. plant handles cleaning, milling, and pelleting operations, while the engineering team develops custom conveyor systems and complete facility layouts.

Its customers span agricultural producers and processors working with hemp, pulses, plant-based proteins, seeds, and other natural materials. The company has been cited in regional news for its role in Montana’s hemp and pulse processing sectors and for supporting plant-based protein supply chains.

Ag Processing Solutions emphasizes tailored engineering and the ability to handle nearly any commodity through its toll processing line, positioning itself as a single-source partner for facility design, equipment fabrication, and contract processing.
